Written 2026-10-27T15:09Z. Read-only: `git fetch` of the head into a review ref, `git show` / `git grep` on it and on the merge-base, GitHub GET only; nothing built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **Counts — the dev's 11 holds; the card's 33 is the non-pair.** Re-derived statically from the head's tree. Spec `ObjectFormPropsSchema` (`component.zod.ts:6840-6958`, second `strictObject` argument) authors 39 keys; the mirror at the merge-base (50 keys plus `BaseSchema`'s 16) lacked exactly `contentLayout`, `confirmOnDiscard` (2), at head 0. Spec `ObjectCalendarPropsSchema` (`:6077-6151`) authors 10 keys; the merge-base mirror (14 plus base) lacked exactly `locale`, `loading` (2), at head 0. Spec `FormFieldSchema` is `FormFieldBaseSchema.extend({ fields }).strict()` (`view.zod.ts:3467, 3790`), 29 keys; against `form.zod.ts` `FormFieldSchema` (72 keys) the spec-only set is `disclosure field helpText immutable keyField precision publicPicker` — exactly the 7 rows. 2 + 2 + 7 = 11. The spec `strictObject` helper keeps `aliases` / `guidanceSets` out of the shape (`packages/spec/src/shared/strict-object.ts:59-80`: they build the unknown-key error map), so no alias key such as the calendar row's `filters` hides as spec-only; the census's 0-unrecorded reading is consistent with the static read. The 33: `actionObject()` (`action.zod.ts:903-1865`) declares 41 keys plus the `MetadataProtectionFields` spread, of which 11 (`confirmText description errorMessage icon label method name onSuccess successMessage type variant`) are also on `CRUDActionSchema` ∪ `BaseSchema` — about 30–33 spec-only on the spec `ActionSchema` against objectui's unrelated `type: 'action'` node. That is the card's number, and it is not a real-pair gap. Premise correction accepted.

2. **The 4 derived keys are authored on the node and read by the renderer; none is an item-1 key.** Spec: `component.zod.ts:6911` `contentLayout: z.enum(['simple', 'tabbed']).optional()`, `:6913` `confirmOnDiscard: z.boolean().optional()`, `:6135` `locale: z.string().optional()`, `:6136` `loading: z.boolean().optional()` — node members of the `object-form` / `object-calendar` rows. Renderer reads: `ModalForm.tsx:954` (`schema.contentLayout === 'tabbed'` with more than one group), `ModalForm.tsx:382` and `DrawerForm.tsx:289` (`schema.confirmOnDiscard !== false`), `plugin-calendar/src/index.tsx:271,273` (`resolveAuthoredLocale(rest.locale)`, `resolveExternalLoading(rest.loading)`) and `calendar-view-renderer.tsx:329`. Mirror by reference on both faces: `objectql.zod.ts:1042-1043, 3182-3183` through the established `stripImportedDefaults(SpecX).shape.KEY` pattern (`:975 layout` is the precedent; `imported-defaults.ts:382` returns the walked node, so the identity pin in the census is sound), `objectql.ts:2288, 2296, 4322, 4329` through the already-imported `SpecObjectFormProps` / `SpecObjectCalendarProps`. Item 1's hand-off type is `Pick` of the five field-name keys only (`ObjectCalendar.tsx:148-150`); at the merge-base neither face declared any of the four (0 hits), so nothing item 1 moved off returns. `ObjectFormSlotKey` carries both form keys (`objectql.ts:2505-2506`); the `object-form` block arm already derives the whole row (`objectql.zod.ts:4727`) and refuses the flat spelling there, unchanged. No declared-but-unread key.

3. **The 7 FormField rows: recording is honest, and ruling 6412606977 is respected.** The two `FormFieldSchema`s are different layers (runtime widget config vs. spec form-view entry; ruling objectui#3090, enforced by the `no-restricted-imports` tripwire at `ui/eslint.config.js:239-257`), so deriving by reference would cross the layer and refusing would contradict `normalizeSectionField`. Verified per row: `sectionFields.ts:181-187` reads `field` as the runtime `name`; `:417, 460, 461` copy `immutable`, `keyField`, `disclosure` onto the runtime field, and `git grep` finds no non-test reader of those three on the runtime field under `plugin-form`, `components`, `fields`; `precision` reaches only the `fields` number formatters as a parameter (`fields/src/index.tsx:663`), not from the runtime form field; `publicPicker` is a spec `retiredKey()` tombstone. Strict face refuses the 7 (derived from declared keys), tolerant face passes them unexamined, spec accepts six of them — that disagreement is the layer boundary the rows now name, not a defect of this PR. `form.ts:1945` index signature untouched (the file is not in the diff).

4. **Rename complete, no alias, consistent with `!`.** `crud.zod.ts:81` `CRUDActionSchema`; `dialog.actions` (:105), `chain` (:135), `DetailSchema.actions` (:205), `CRUDDialogSchema.actions` (:276), the union cast (:306) and `CRUDActionSchemaType` (:328) all renamed; barrel `index.zod.ts:378`. `git grep` at head: no importer of a zod `ActionSchema` from `@object-ui/types/zod` or `crud.zod` outside the changeset's own Before/Fix lines; `ActionSchemaType` / `CRUDActionSchemaType` have 0 importers; `'ActionSchema' in ZodBarrel` is pinned false in the census. No deprecated alias is kept, which is what the `!` title and the BREAKING banner say. The TS twin `crud.ts:40` `ActionSchema` already carried `@deprecated` (towards `UIActionSchema`) and is unchanged, as the changeset states. One prose leftover: `ui/content/docs/core/enhanced-actions.mdx:304` still says the shape is refused by "`ActionSchema`'s zod schema" — now `CRUDActionSchema`; cosmetic, fix with the next head.

5. **Declarations.** `Clause-②`: the PR's `yes (narrowing)` is right for this diff and the claim's `no (narrowing)` is not. The diff widens a published accept set and the public face — the strict authoring face (`strict-authoring-face.ts`, derived from declared keys) now accepts `contentLayout`, `confirmOnDiscard`, `locale`, `loading` that it refused as unrecognised keys before; the `ObjectFormSchema` / `ObjectCalendarSchema` interfaces gain four optional members; `CRUDActionSchema` and `CRUDActionSchemaType` are new names on the `./zod` entry — and it narrows (the tolerant face refuses bad values at the key's own path; the old export name is gone). `execution-duties.md:66` makes `yes` the answer to 「判据:本卡放宽接受集或扩大公开面吗」; line 105, 「收窄已发布接受集的卡是 `Clause-②: no`,不移车道;入队前欠一次契约复审档复核」, names the pure-narrowing card; `record-recognisers.mjs:188, 1628` read `yes (narrowing)` as "a diff that widens and narrows owes the narrowing review" — this face, this tier. Same disposition the seat amended the #26411 claim to. `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` is right under the precedence rule (narrowed over added); the claim's `widened` is outside the closed set, as the dev reported. `Skills-docs: none — REASON`: true for what it names (`react-blocks.md:27-28` teaches both form keys; no `skills/**` page names the zod `ActionSchema`; both docs importers are in the diff), but it says nothing about `object-calendar` `locale` / `loading`, which no `skills/**` or `ui/content/docs` page teaches — the spec's `.describe()` rows are the only teaching. `none` stands; the reason should name them on the next head.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/25923-spec-only-keys-crud-action-schema.md`: `'@object-ui/types': minor`, `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, BREAKING Before / Now / Fix with the FROM / TO import rewrite and the `contentLayout` value fix. Matches what the diff publishes: `@object-ui/types` (18.2.0, public, `./zod` subpath) is the only package that moves; `ui/content/docs/**` is not a package. Kind `narrowed` takes at least `minor` on that package (AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist 3), so `minor` is the level; the `!` in the title and the changeset summary agree with the `(narrowing)` arm. The claim's `Metadata-protocol: widened` is malformed; the dev's `narrowed` is the reading.
- Dogfood battery owed by `!` / `(narrowing)` (review-checklist:51): dev-reported at this head, exit 0, 302 files passed; not re-run here.
- ADR-0087 marker `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`: the body's Fix line (`:25`) is a FROM / TO rewrite of a consumer import — a migration prescription in substance. The gate's own header (`check-adr-0087-registration.mjs:147-154`) says the category is refused when the body carries one, and (`:203-213`) that an exemption held by a detector miss is the anti-pattern it was written against; the dev states in the changeset and the report that the pass rests on the detector not reading the arrowless line, and that `runtime-export-retired` refuses a `*.zod.ts` operand on the `./zod` subpath. Precedent in this lane: #25926 and #26411 (contract review PASS 6436950621) carry the same category beside a Fix line. Escalated in ③, not a FAIL reason on its own.

### ③ Boundary flags

1. **FAIL — required context `Lint UI` is `failure` on this head, and the diff causes it.** `ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/zod-mirror-parity.test.ts:961` adds `import * as SpecUi from '@objectstack/spec/ui'`; the job's annotation on that line reads: namespace import is invalid because 'FormField' and 'FormFieldSchema' from '@objectstack/spec/ui' are restricted (`no-restricted-imports`, `ui/eslint.config.js:247-257`, the objectui#3090 tripwire); `pnpm run lint` in `ui/packages/types` exited 1 (job 122248905282, completed 2026-10-27T14:35Z). The one sanctioned namespace import of that module, `spec-ui-schema-reexports.test.ts:23-25`, carries `eslint-disable-next-line no-restricted-imports` with its reason on the line above. Fix on the next head: named imports for the schemas the census reads, or that disable line with the reason that this census is the sanctioned cross-layer instrument. The report's gate line (`dispatch-gates --ran` 34/34) did not cover ui lint and said "CI check-runs on the PR: not yet reported"; the next report reads them. A new head is a new record.
2. Deviation `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` against the claim's `no (narrowing)` — accepted (①.5); the seat rewrites the claim line. Deviation `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` against the claim's `widened` — accepted.
3. ADR-0087 disposition — escalated to the seat: either rule that `no-migration-prescription` stands for a `./zod`-subpath export rename on the lane's precedent (#25926, #26411), or file the gate gap (`runtime-export-retired` cannot name a `*.zod.ts` operand outside the main entry) as its own card. The changeset text need not change for either.
4. `Skills-docs:` reason — name the calendar keys' coverage on the next head (①.5); not a REWORK on its own.
5. Out-of-scope finding "immutable / keyField / disclosure / precision carried, not rendered": `immutable` accepted by the spec, copied by `normalizeSectionField`, enforced by no renderer, is declared ≠ enforced on an edit-mode form (Prime Directive #10); the dev recorded it in the Acceptance notes with reach unmeasured and filed no card. Seat: file it, or fold it into the FormField follow-up row on #25923 at ACCEPT.
6. Prose leftover `enhanced-actions.mdx:304` (①.4) — fix with the lint head.
7. #26365 also edits `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` in other regions — ordinary concurrency; the later lander merges `main` and re-runs that file.
